verdict.rationale: Operating a desktop OS through natural-language commands is a fair axis, since an OS could ship an assistant, so this story applies to Fedora Workstation. The evidence only shows Super-key type-to-search and a single-command package install, which are keyword search and shell commands, not natural-language operation. No first-party natural-language or assistant capability is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
